transcript: In this exercise, Commander, we'll show you how to build and command offensive units. You may be a hot shot pilot, but rest assured you'll find comfort in numbers if you find yourself attacking enemy installations.
Engineering has tooled your Recycler to build a wide variety of munitions. Use the command interface to order the Recycler to build a Scout.
Order the Recycler to build a Factory.
Good. All factories require a power source just like the Recycler. Use your command interface to order the Unit Factory to deploy on a geyser.
You've now built an offensive unit. Let's use your offensive scout to attack an enemy target. Open a comms channel with your scout.
Press the <kbd>1</kbd> key to have your Recycler build a Scout.
You can command a wingman just like a Turret, but the wingman does not have to deploy in order to be effective in combat.

I've put a Nav Beacon in the combat area. Nav Beacons serve as spy cameras in the world, and you can also use them as staging points for gathering units. Hit the <kbd>4</kbd> key to access the list of active cameras. Then hit the <kbd>1</kbd> key to select the first camera.
Notice the spy camera in the top right corner of your HUD.
Open a comms channel with your wingman.
Order your wingman to the active Nav Beacon by hitting the <kbd>Alt</kbd> key.
Wingmen will automatically engage enemy targets when they come into close proximity.
Notice how your wingman blinks in the radar when it is under attack. This will inform you whenever one of your units is under attack.
Kick back and watch your wingman take care of business.
Good work. Use your scout to destroy the next drone.
Stop before you get into range of the enemy unit.
Don't engage the drone.
Hit the <kbd>T</kbd> key to target the drone.
Now open a comms channel with your wingman.
Press the <kbd>3</kbd> key to see the available enemy targets and then pick the target you would like your wingman to attack. You can fight with your wingman if you'd like.
Good job, Commander. Now head back to the base.
Order your Factory to deploy on a power supply.
Point your smart reticle at a geyser and press the space bar.
Select the Recycler.
Send the Recycler to a geyser.

In this mission, we'll introduce you to factories. Factories reprocess a material we call bio-metal scrap into new vehicles, weapons, and supplies. We found scrap fields around the moon that probably came from meteor showers. Engineering has created Scavenger units which are like big mobile vacuum cleaners designed to gather scrap.
The Recycler is the key unit in building a base. I've set it as your active objective. Open a comms channel with the Recycler.

The Recycler exists in a deployed and mobile state. It can only build units when it is deployed over a geyser power source. This Recycler is currently deployed. Press the <kbd>0</kbd> key to get it to pack up and ready to relocate to a geyser near a scrap field.

Good. The Recycler is now ready to move. Use your command interface to open a comm channel with the Recycler and order it to follow you to a new geyser at checkpoint one. Keep in mind that the Recycler is big and slow, may not be able to keep up with you.
All right. Let's open a comms channel with the Recycler and order it to deploy on the geyser.

Point your smart reticle at the geyser and notice that the diamond on the ground changes to a white line. The command interface automatically recognizes that the Recycler has a special interaction with the geyser. Press the Spacebar while pointing at the geyser to get the Recycler to deploy on the power source.
Great. Now have the Recycler build a Scavenger. Open a comms channel with the Recycler.
Scavengers will gather bio-metal on their own. However, you will need to protect your Scavengers because they don't have any weapons. Protect that Scavenger. I'm gonna send a drone to attack it.
Press the <kbd>1</kbd> key to have the Recycler build a Scavenger.
Notice the scrap display in your HUD. You'll need to keep tabs on your scrap supply in order to make smart building choices.
We're done with this exercise, Commander.
Press the <kbd>1</kbd> key to have the Recycler follow you.
You didn't protect the Scavenger. You're not ready for combat, Commander.
Good shooting, Commander. That enemy is scrap.
Good job, Commander. We're done here.

Welcome to the Moon, Commander. I'm gonna walk you through combat training. The general wants all NSDF command posts prepared to defend themselves. The future of our country depends on our success here in space. Get into our experimental scout tank. Let's go for a test drive through the pylons ahead. Press <kbd>O</kbd> to review your current objectives.
Let's get the course done sometime today, Commander.
You're outside the course, Commander.
Good job, Commander. You're approaching the rim of a bio-metal quarry. Drive over the edge and use your jump thrusters to cushion your landing.
Nice landing.
Easy, Commander. That's an expensive piece of machinery.
Now, let's get you out of that crater by jumping from ledge to ledge. Proceed to the eastern edge of the quarry and follow the pylons out of the hole. Use your jump thrusters to cross the ledges.
You still have some jumps left.
Good job, Commander. Head for the target range.
Okay, Commander. Drive to the next crater and use your missiles and cannons to destroy the dummy targets. Notice the active weapon in the lower right side of your HUD.
Try to use your strafe thrusters to present your enemy with a moving target. Also, remember to monitor your ammo and vehicle status with the gauges in your HUD.
Good. Move on to the next target.
Excellent, Commander. You've made our engineering team proud. Let's move on.
We think the V-Thruster is capable of doing the course faster, but that time will certainly do. Let's move on.

To help keep track of enemies, press <kbd>T</kbd> to target them. As long as your enemy remains in radar range, he will appear in your target camera, and the arrows in your HUD will identify its direction.

One last thing, Commander. Let's get familiar with the new command system in your V-Thruster. Up ahead you'll find a T-4 Badger Turret. I'll add it to your control interface. Let's go through the steps of positioning the Turret on the battlefield.
To open communications with the Turret, you can point your smart reticle at it triggering the select command. Pressing the space bar will then select the unit.

Good. Notice the list of commands in the left side of your HUD. At the top of that list is the smart reticle command that the unit will execute if you press the spacebar again. When you point your reticle at the ground, a diamond marking the location where you could send that unit will appear. Pressing the spacebar will order the unit to the new location. Once there, the Turret will deploy and defend its position. Go ahead and try it.
A moving turret has no usable weapons, but once deployed it provides a powerful defense. Watch the Turret demonstrate its firepower on the approaching target.
Good work, Commander.
Uh, Commander, do you really think you can complete this course on foot? Get into that V-Thruster.
Commander, I'm losing patience with your incompetence. We'll try this again later.

Okay, Commander. Today we'll practice using the command interface. We've got a T-7 Badger turret up ahead. The T-7 is an excellent defensive weapon when deployed, but it's very vulnerable when moving. Let's walk through the steps of commanding the Turret.

Open a comms channel with your turret by using the command interface in the top left of your HUD. When a menu is green, you have units in that category. Press the <kbd>2</kbd> key to view your defensive units.
Good. Press <kbd>Shift</kbd> to close the comms channel. I want to show you another way to open a comms channel when you don't have a visual on a unit.

Open a comms channel with your turret by using the command interface in the top left of your HUD. When a menu is green, you have units in that category. Press the <kbd>2</kbd> key to view your defensive units.

Notice the green line drawn into the radar. This will help you keep track of your units on the battlefield. At the bottom of each line in the radar, you will see a green-colored circle with a number in it. Press the <kbd>1</kbd> key to select your Turret.
Now, we're ready to give the Turret an order. Press the <kbd>1</kbd> key to command the selected Turret to follow you.
Now, let's order the Turret to deploy. Open a comms channel with the Turret.
Good. Let's get the Turret to deploy. Point your smart reticle at the ground and press the space bar to order the Turret to move to that position and deploy.
Good job. Let's watch the Turret destroy a drone.
That ends the exercise, Commander. We'll debrief at Eagles Nest One.
Now press <kbd>1</kbd> to select the Turret.
Press <kbd>2</kbd> to select your defensive units.
Drive to the checkpoint and the T-7 will follow behind you. Keep in mind that not all units move at the same speed, so they might get separated when traveling in a convoy.

Commander, we have successfully landed four platoons on Venus in preparation for attacking the CCA's main base at Nav Beacon 2. You'll command our troops on the northern flank. Commander Eldridge will lead the Colorado attacking from the west at Nav Beacon 3. His APCs will lead the attack on the Soviet’s Gun Tower.
Justice, we're under attack (static). Send all units, we’re under attack. (static)
We're under attack by forces of unknown origin. (static) Ship of unknown configuration. (static)
Colorado, restate. Last message unclear.
(scream)
Grizzly One. We've lost contact with the Colorado. Continue with current orders and stand by for Sky-Eye recon.
I'm picking up something big on your radar, Commander.
Commander, Sky-Eye cannot match the configuration of that ship with any known Soviet craft. Approach with extreme caution.
Sky-Eye is picking up an unidentified object to the west. Stand by.
Sky-Eye has picked up an unidentified object to the east. Stand by.
Grizzly One, the Colorado has been destroyed. You are on your own. Amass your forces and take out that CCA base.
I'm picking up another one of those things to the east!
I'm picking up another one of those things to the west!
We've got another one, Commander!
We've got another unidentified object heading your way from the east. We're dropping a Nav Camera there now.
We've got another unidentified object coming from the west. We're dropping a Nav Beacon there.
Pull out, Commander! What the Sam Hill is that?
Uh, Justice, this is Eldridge from the Colorado. We are encountering moderate fighter resistance. Looks like they don't want to fight. Are you guys sure they know we're here?

Well done, Grizzly One. You have struck a decisive blow for the NSDF. We are... stand by… Grizzly One, a platoon of CCA forces have escaped the assault. We are airlifting you to intercept coordinates. Stand by.

Grizzly One, it looks like you've stumbled into a ruined city. Stand by. Intelligence indicates that those are the ruins of Styx. Preliminary bio-metal readings indicate that those walking machines were probably derived from those ruins. Well done, Grizzly One. Now carry out your orders.

Well done, Grizzly One. The Soviets have been destroyed. Sky-Eye indicates that there is a large deposit of alien artifacts just to the north of where the Soviets set up that base. Looks like the ruins of a city. Intelligence wants to know if it has anything to do with those walking machines. Find those artifacts, Commander, and we will lift you out of the area. Collins out.
That's not it, Commander. The ruins we're looking for are on a much larger scale and in a much more concentrated area. Continue searching.

Commander, we're picking up what you're seeing. Intelligence indicates that the entire area is scattered with alien relics. Identify as many as you can, but I am more concerned with that base, Commander. Carry on.
Commander, you have lost the Utah. Attention all NSDF forces. We must withdraw from the area. Mission aborted.
Commander, are you hard of hearing? I have given you a direct order to stay clear of the Colorado. Return to base and carry out my orders, now!
Grizzly One, the Colorado has been destroyed. You are on your own. Amass your forces and take out that CCA base.
On it, sir. Grizzly One, I will relay the coordinates to you now. Corbett out.

With the Radar Array destroyed, we landed a massive force on Venus, and quickly moved to gain control of the relic. We were cocky, thinking that we'd march right through the Soviet lines. We were in for a major surprise.

Sky-Eye has discovered a structure built on the side of a Martian volcano. We need you to inspect the area from the ground and establish a perimeter around the structure that will shut down all possible CCA access points. Initial scouting parties have found that all of the gullies are heavily mined. Stay on the ridges to avoid these hazards. Good luck.
I'm not picking up any structures around the volcano, Commander.
There it is. Lieutenant Corbett, Grizzly One has found the structure.
Good job, Commander. Recon the object and shut down all passages to the structure.
Commander, incoming CCA forces!
Grizzly One, you must hold that factory at all costs. Commander Eldridge and the 6th platoon will supply reinforcements. Hold off the CCA until then. Collins out.
Grizzly One, this is Commander Eldridge of the Sixth Platoon. We're ten minutes out.
Looks like that's the last of 'em, Commander. They probably realized the 6th was coming and turned tail.
Stay sharp, Corporal, and secure that factory until the sixth arrives.
Incoming Bombers, Commander. They're headed toward the factory. We've got to pick them up before they can get into range to destroy it.
Commander Eldridge here. The 6th is at your command.
Good work, Commander. The factory is secure.
Grizzly One, I leave you alone for two seconds and you're blowing up our Recycler! When Commander Eldridge gets there, you are relieved of command.
All units, fall back. Good job, Grizzly One. I give you one simple task and you can't get the job done!
I don't believe it. Grizzly One, we may have hit the jackpot with this one. This structure is called Lemnos. It was the alien factory that produced the bio-metal.
General, Grizzly One has eliminated the CCA Recycler.
Good work, Commander. Now, clean up any stray CCA units that could take out that factory.

The object we discovered when we first touched down on Mars, confirmed the nagging feeling in the back of all of our minds. We knew the bio-metal wasn't natural. Someone... or something had created it. Now we held an object that contained their complete historical record. Locked away within its enigmatic recesses were untold weapons and vehicles and countless anecdotes that would tell us who these people were, and where they'd gone. For now all we knew was a name. The Cthonians, but we had a new imperative. We had to explore every nook and cranny of the planet's surface. We had to learn everything that they knew. We became anthropologists uncovering a lost civilization whose knowledge could literally raise us amongst the gods, and whose weight could crush us forever.

Commander, in order for our Venusian assault to begin, you must take out the Soviets' Radar Array inside their outpost to the north. Sky-Eye indicates that the outpost is fortified with Gun Towers, and Soviet Fighters are patrolling the entire area. Take your strike team, find a way inside that outpost, and destroy the radar array. Lieutenant Eldridge’s team has already scouted the area. Rendezvous with him at Nav Beacon 1 before you start your assault. Collins out.

This is Commander Eldridge at your disposal, Commander. I've just received word from my scout, Razor One, that he's located the outpost and dropped a Nav Camera at its location. Let's check it out, but keep an eye out for Soviet runners trying to get back to warn the others.
Razor One reporting. I've worked my way up to a peak above the outpost. Looks like we could eject into the base from here. I'll drop a Nav Beacon here now. Razor One out.
Razor One reporting. I'm beyond a minefield east of the outpost. The Soviets are up to something. I'm gonna drop a Nav Beacon for you to check out.
Commander, I'm under attack and need assistance. Meet (static) Nav 5. Follow the Nav Beacons to get through (static) the minefield.
One of ‘em is making a break for it, sir!
That got 'em.
Uh, our runner's gotten back to base. We've been detected. The heat's on now.
(Radar Array alarm).
I've tripped the outpost alarm. They're on to us, sir.
Commander, you've set off the alarm. They're on to us, sir.
William Stahl is the greatest designer known to man!
notes: This is an easter egg related to Razor One discovering the minefield and CCA test range; it seems to be unreachable in the final version of the mission.

transcript: Commander, you have lost the Utah. Your mission is lost.
Excellent work, Commander. I'd say you are shaping up to be a shining star in the NSDF.

Excellent work, Commander. The Radar Array is down and we're ready to begin our assault. Rendezvous with the Recycler Utah and her Unit Factory. We've dropped a Nav Beacon at her location. Set up a base and destroy the Soviet Recycler to the north. We've dropped a Nav Camera there as well. Hurry, Commander.
Yee-haw!
Commander, we'll never make it by those Gun Towers in one piece. Collins was right. We'll have to find another way into that outpost. The front door's locked up tight.
Razor One reporting. I've worked my way up to a peak above the outpost. Looks like we could eject into the base from here. I'll drop a Nav Beacon. Razor One out.
Glad you could make it, sir. Volcano’s interfering with our communications. We can make it from here into the outpost. Follow me, I'm going in!
Rendezvous with the Recycler Utah and her Unit Factory. We've dropped a Nav Camera at her location. Set up a base and destroy the Soviets Recycler to the north. There's a Nav Camera there as well.

There was no love to be found on Venus. Only vengeance. We were there to take back the relic we lost on Mars. But it was so much more to all of us. This was a time for us to strike back for the countless friends we'd lost during the savage attack on the Moon. As we dropped through the churning atmosphere, the bolts of lightning and the putrid green clouds set the stage for what lay ahead. We were about to launch the biggest invasion since Normandy. We weren't taking any chances, and we weren't taking any prisoners.
We beat the Soviets to the relics, and finally took the upper hand. Now came our move to fully take advantage of our newfound prize.

It's imperative that we get the relics off Io and back to our engineering facilities on Mars. Your platoon will escort the transports from the base to the Launch Pad. I've attached some tanks from the Eighth Platoon to your command. The convoy will follow the Nav Beacons, so you may want to take your forces to scout ahead.
Moving out.
Grizzly One. One of the transports is breaking from its pre-programmed path.
Farewell, bourgeois, imperialist pigs!
Arkin? What's with the accent? Hey! He's stealing the transport! That bastard's a mole!
Grizzly One, pursue Transport 3 with extreme caution. It is essential that we hold transports 1 and 2. Repeat, do not lose transports 1 and 2.
We detect heavy forces ahead, Commander. We're stopping the convoy till the path is cleared.
Collins here. Additional CCA forces are entering your area. They're moving in to attack the Launch Pad.

Grizzly One, we've lost the Launch Pad that was your destination. Lieutenant Corbett is setting up another Launch Pad. We'll drop a Nav Beacon at the Launch Pad's position as soon as preparations are complete.
Commander, we've established a second Launch Pad. Escort the remaining transports there.
One of the transports has been destroyed.
Commander, this convoy is a disaster. It's not enough that the CCA stole one of the Furies. You've got to go and let them blow another one up.
Commander, losing Arkin’s transport is a significant setback, but you performed well under the circumstances. Now, it's time to capture that traitor.
Commander, do not attempt to recover Transport 3. Repeat, do not attempt to recover transport 3. Sky-Eye detects a massive CCA force in that area. Protect the other two transports.
Good work, Grizzly One. The information has been recorded. Continue on your mission.
We've lost the Command Tower, Grizzly One. Looks like you'd better learn to speak Russian.
Commander, we've lost the Solar Arrays. Looks like you better learn to speak Russian.
The Soviets destroyed the transport, Commander. A lot of good men are dead. I'm sure you'll have time to think about that, since we don't have any way to get home.

Satellite recon indicates that an overwhelming Soviet strike force has just landed to the north and to the west. I'm ordering a full evacuation of Eagles Nest 1. Repeat, we are pulling out of Eagles Nest 1.
Commander, all of our key personnel have reached transports 1 and 2. Disregard all previous orders and escort these two transports to the north Launch Pad.
Grizzly One. Escort the transports to the northern Launch Pad.
Nice job, Grizzly One. Now, get to the Launch Pad.

This is General Collins, Commander. You're just in time. The first Soviet attack has destroyed all of Eagle's Nest One's defenses. Check your radar. We've got additional Soviet forces coming in from the southeast. They're targeting the Command Tower and our Solar Arrays. Protect these structures at all costs. If we lose them, we're finished.

The Soviet forces are withdrawing, Commander. It won't be long before they regroup for another attack. The NSDF Recycler Montana has been called back to the base. She's a training vehicle, but she does have Turret building capabilities. Use her to build some turrets and set up a defensive perimeter around the base.
Commander, reinforcements are returning from Outpost 2. Rendezvous at the Northern Solar Array.
Commander, take up a position in front of the transports and look out for Soviet blockades.
Well done, Commander. Well done. Attention all NSDF forces. We have successfully evacuated all ground personnel. However, we have lost Eagle's Nest 1 to the Soviets.
We underestimated the Soviet strength. And we underestimated their commitment to controlling the bio-metal.
Now their intentions are clear. And if it's a war they want, then it's a war they shall get. We're relocating to Mars, where we will reassert our standing as the world's greatest superpower.
The action on the Moon got intense, but it was only the beginning of what was to come. The Soviet surprise attack caught us all with our pants down. We never even had time to bury our dead.

By the end of our time on Mars, we'd all learn to question our individual value in the grand scheme of things. Collins gave us orders that left some of our people to die. Nobody wants to be responsible for their friend's death. But no general wants to be responsible for losing a war. We learned to trust our generals and to follow their orders. But we all feared the day that we would be abandoned and left to die.

Grizzly One. Commander Simmons and the 5th Platoon are locked down in battle with a full CCA platoon at the Olympus Mons ruins. They've just lost the Recycler Minnesota. You must escort the Recycler Wyoming to rescue Simmons and the 5th Platoon. There is a CCA base in the canyons to the north of your route that may complicate your mission. Take all precaution to avoid conflict until you reach the 5th. Collins out.
Grizzly One, Sky-Eye is picking up a large object in the area. We've got recon orders from Lieutenant Corbett. I'm entering the coordinates into your computer now. Corporal Buzz out.
Look at the size of that thing. I'm picking up bio-metal inside the hull. Some sort of transport ship. General, Grizzly One has located the Hephaestus.
Grizzly One, access your information database to see if we can get anything else from this.

Stand by for new mission priority, Grizzly One. Head to Nav Beacon One and recon the Starport mentioned in the Hephaestus's log. It could provide additional information on where the Cthonians have been.
But General, the 5th.
I am well aware of the 5th’s situation, Lieutenant, but this relic could tip the balance of the war. You have your orders, Grizzly One.
Grizzly One. Search each of the structures and locate the flight log database. We're lucky the CCA hasn't pilfered the site yet.
Look at all that bio-metal. It must have scattered everywhere when the Hephaestus crashed.
Good work, Grizzly One. According to the information, there should be another alien relic resembling the database we found earlier.
Commander, CCA patrol approaching from the canyon!
General. Commander Simmons reports that the CCA platoon is retreating to the CCA base in the canyon.
They know we're here. They're pulling back to protect the flight log. Continue to build your platoon and hold for further orders, Commander.
General, Sky-Eye reports that a transport is lifting off from the CCA base.
They're trying to get the database off Mars. Grizzly One, continue with your assault. We'll try and cut them off from up here. Lieutenant, order the Lincoln and the Roosevelt to set a blockade.
One minute, sir.
Damn, that's not enough time.
How long before the CCA platoon makes it back?
Eight minutes.

Well, we may not be able to stop them from getting the relic on the transport, but we can find out where they're headed. Grizzly One, you are to use the Wyoming and penetrate the canyon's defenses. Take the base, but do it quick. The CCA platoon that was fighting the fifth is headed your way. Lieutenant, what are the closest ships to the CCA destroyers?
The Lincoln and the Roosevelt, sir.
Order them to set a blockade. Contact the Freedom and request their assistance. Collins out.
Transport has touched down.
CCA transport has lifted off and is rejoining the escort destroyers.
General, the Lincoln is under attack.
Mayday, Mayday, Justice, this is Lincoln. We are taking heavy fire. CCA transports trying to leave orbit. Roosevelt has not yet arrived. Need assistance. Our engines are…
General, the Lincoln has been destroyed and the transport has gotten away.

Grizzly One, a transport carrying the flight log has escaped. Proceed to the CCA Launch Pad and inspect it to determine the transport's destination. You'll have to move quickly before the CCA platoon returns to fortify the base. Sky-Eye reports that you have about nine minutes. Good luck, Commander. Collins out.
General, Grizzly One has recon’d the Launch Pad.
Excellent work, Commander. Now get the Wyoming to the dust-off site. Lieutenant Corbett will drop a Nav Beacon. Good work, Grizzly One.
Three minutes before CCA platoon arrives.
Grizzly One, this is Commander Simmons. I don't know how long we can hold on. I've lost half my platoon. Hurry to the Launch Pad, ASAP!
Grizzly One, this is Commander Simmons. There's only a few of us left. We can't hold out much longer.
Grizzly One, we're going to make one last stand at this pass. We've got about two minutes at best. Get to the Launch Pad.
Grizzly One, Commander Simmons. I can't hold (explosion).
I'm picking up a massive scrap field ahead, sir. Looks like the Hephaestus's cargo got... Uh, radar contact! CCA units in the scrap field!
Good job, Commander. We have the transport's coordinates. Escort your Recycler to the dust off site. We've dropped a Nav Beacon. Corbett out.
Good job, Grizzly One. You've penetrated the CCA base. Recon their Launch Pad.
Good job, Commander. Mission successful.
The transport has left the canyons and is rejoining the escort destroyers.
Grizzly One, this is Commander Simmons of the 5th Platoon. Looks like you need some more time. We're gonna hold off the CCA platoon so you can get to the Launch Pad.
Negative, Commander. In your current condition you will not stand a chance. You are ordered to stand down.
Sorry, Lieutenant. I can't do that. Simmons out. All units, move into attack formation.
Simmons, come in. Simmons. Darn it. Grizzly One, they're not gonna last long. You've got to get through quickly.
General, the 5th has been wiped out and Grizzly One has failed to recon the Launch Pad.

Good job, Grizzly One. We've taken heavy losses, but we know where they took the flight log. We're breaking off our attack and the CCA platoon is not pursuing. But they are headed your way. Move your forces to the dust-off site.
Grizzly One, you have about 30 seconds to make sure the 5th‘s deaths weren't in vain. Recon that Launch Pad.
Good job, Commander. Mission successful. Transport is en route.
Looks like we're too late. They must have found the flight log already. Grizzly One, deploy the Wyoming and prepare for an assault on the canyon base.
All personnel, prepare to evacuate Mars. Oh, not you, Commander. I've got a special assignment for you. In one of the polar regions!
Yes, sir.
General, we've lost the Wyoming.
Grizzly One. Search each of the structures and locate the flight log database.
Commander, you have been ordered to recon that object.
Commander, we are still waiting for you to call up information on the Hephaestus.
Commander, identify and search each of those buildings.
Commander, your failure to carry out a simple order leaves me with no choice but to charge you with insubordination. You are relieved of command.
Commander, you are ordered to head to Nav Beacon One and recon that Starport.

The Soviets are transmitting data from a secret communication tower located somewhere on Europa. Included in the data transmission is the whereabouts of the stolen Fury relic. We need to intercept that transmission before it ends. Your heads-up clock indicates how much time is left before the transmission is complete and your objective is lost. Here are your orders. Just north of you is a Soviet Check-Point Tower. You'll find a patrol ship passes by this checkpoint at regular intervals. You are to head there on foot. Take out a CCA pilot as he comes in using your sniper rifle and commandeer his vehicle. And, Commander, you'll need to keep a low profile or risk giving yourself away. Once you've acquired a Soviet vehicle, we'll issue you further instructions. Good luck, Grizzly One.
Initiating communication uplink.
Losing communication uplink.
Communication uplink lost.
Data interception complete. Communication uplink terminated.
Scout, you have checked in out of order. Return to your post.
Omega one, identify yourself immediately!
This is checkpoint two reporting. All clear, Omega One.
This is checkpoint three reporting. All clear, Omega One.
This is checkpoint four reporting. All clear, Omega One.
Looks like you found your way, Omega One… Ahahaha.
All units. Omega One is not responding. Believed hostile. Engage and destroy!
(Transmission interception sound effect.)
notes: This sound is the “Restore Up” sound from the “Inside Your Computer” theme from the Windows 95 Plus! pack.

transcript: Your cover is blown, Commander. You left your tank out in the open.
Omega One, you have checked in out of order and are wasting time. Explain yourself!
You have run out of time, Commander. The message has been transmitted. You have failed.
Well done, Commander. Stand by. Reinforcements are in motion, Commander.
Good, Commander. But we're just getting started. Now, pay attention. To keep from drawing attention to yourself, you must complete this ship's patrol route.
First you must find this Turret repair and supply hangar.
Secondly, you must go to this Mobile Unit Factory.
Finally, you must find these scrap silos.
There are two Check-Point Towers that will help you locate these structures. Identify them using the <kbd>I</kbd> key and they will activate Nav Cameras that will show you the way.

After you've completed the patrol route, waste no time locating that communication tower. To intercept the transmission, you need only stay close to the tower for a few seconds. Your onboard computer will do the rest. Once you've got the transmission, get back to the drop zone at Nav 1. Now go, Commander.
Excellent work, Commander. Now get back to Nav 1 as fast as you can.
This is Razor One. Thanks for rescuing me. I was captured on Venus. I know a fast way out of here. Follow me.
To the east is the Soviets' main scrap supply silos. Taking them out would seriously cripple the CCA's ability to fight here on Europa.

Walking alone with no support, a lone capitalist on a planet of communist. relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hidden Enemy/bd02003.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hidden Enemy/bd02004.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hidden Enemy/bd02005.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hidden Enemy/bd02006.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hidden Enemy/bd02008.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hidden Enemy/bd02009.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hidden Enemy/intro02.wav
transcript: After the surprise attack from the Chinese forces, morale was at its lowest. If this new enemy could hide itself so thoroughly, how could we defend ourselves? But to their credit, command pushed us on. We might have complained at the time, but in hindsight, we never would have made it without them. The mission to find the Chinese headquarters was unpopular, to say the least, but we went ahead regardless. We had no idea how much worse things were going to get.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hook, Line, and Sinker/bd08001.wav
transcript: Your main priority is to contain anything emerging from the portal. The command believes that the Chinese will send engineers through to reprogram the portal. You must not obstruct any such mission. Once they've done their job, you are to take control of their vehicle and take it through the portal.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hook, Line, and Sinker/bd08002.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hook, Line, and Sinker/bd08003.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hook, Line, and Sinker/bd08004.wav
transcript: It seems they've done their work now, Lieutenant. Don't let them get away.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hook, Line, and Sinker/bd08005.wav
transcript: You idiot! HQ's long-term strategy revolved around that APC. And you can't even keep your finger off the trigger for three minutes. I’m having you posted to Io effective now!

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hook, Line, and Sinker/bd08006.wav
transcript: How can we get ahead in this war if you keep wasting resources? I hope you like Phobos, Lieutenant, because that's where we send incompetent fools like you.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hook, Line, and Sinker/bd08007.wav
transcript: Well done, Lieutenant. Now we can get to Elysium undetected. Everything seems to be going as planned.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Hook, Line, and Sinker/intro08.wav
transcript: Back on Ganymede with a minimal Chinese presence. They had enjoyed a short period of R and R{{rest and relaxation}}. Then all hell broke loose as the Chinese launched a lightning swift attack on our base camp on Elysium. A lot of good American men died in that attack, but most of us were able to reach the portal in time. It surprised command to say the least. Elysium Outpost One had gone from a stable field HQ to a smoking ruin within an hour and a half, and the badly damaged men and units who came tumbling out of the portal on Ganymede didn't have an opportunity to alert command of the situation. They decided to use more subtle tactics. We decided to sit back and wait for the Chinese to take the bait.

Lieutenant, to the south of you is the last Chinese base on Ganymede capable of constructing a new portal. At the moment they do not have the necessary resources, but we can't afford to take any chances. You are to assemble an assault team and take out that base. A word of caution though. The enemy has mined the area around the base heavily, and there are numerous gun towers in operation. Be sure you have a sufficient force assembled. We cannot afford to lose this one. Harris out.
SkyEye is reporting an incoming Chinese APC. We believe it's carrying the equipment to build a new portal. You have about ten minutes before it arrives. Stop this shipment at all costs.
The APC is close now, Lieutenant. I suggest you take it out at the earliest opportunity.
Uh, Lieutenant, that APC's getting a little too close for comfort.
Good work, Lieutenant. Now finish the job and take out that Recycler.
That was the last Chinese Recycler on Ganymede. Now we just have to wait for the rest of them to surrender.
Damn, that APC didn't just carry the technology. It was bringing a complete pegasus. Commander Harris is signaling our surrender now.
Without that Recycler, you have a snowball's chance in hell of taking on that Chinese base. Mission aborted. I'm signaling our surrender now, you dope.

At first we thought the Chinese would have no way of rebuilding a Pegasus device, but Command soon heard of a shipment of bio-metal on its way to a Chinese base. They feared it would be the key to Chinese reinforcements. We had no option but to count on the worst case scenario and destroy the Chinese base and the shipment.

If our engineers don't succeed in building a new portal, we're done for. And they've put up a shield around themselves, but it won't last long. Sergeant, protect those men at all costs.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Meanwhile, Back at the Ranch.../bd12002.wav
transcript: Oh yeah, back home to roost. Now where’re those commie bastards?

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Meanwhile, Back at the Ranch.../bd12003.wav
transcript: Good job, Sergeant. I have no doubt you will be suitably rewarded for your competence under stress. Well done.

Thanks to the valor of a very few brave men, we were able to return and give them support, but if it wasn't for a lone sergeant, we would have been stranded for eternity in a dead paradise.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Spilt Milk/bd03005.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Spilt Milk/bd03006.wav
transcript: Man, are we glad to see you, Lieutenant!

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Spilt Milk/bd03007.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Spilt Milk/bd03008.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Spilt Milk/bd03009.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Spilt Milk/bd03010.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Spilt Milk/bd03011.wav
transcript: The loss of manpower because of your incompetence is too great, Lieutenant. We have little choice but to surrender. I am opening a channel to the Chinese commander now. I hope you're proud.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Spilt Milk/bd03012.wav
transcript: You lost the Recycler, Lieutenant. We have little choice but to surrender. I am opening a channel to the Chinese commander now. I hope you're proud.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Spilt Milk/intro03.wav
transcript: If morale was low after the first Chinese attacks, it was non existent after the attack on the headquarters. All over Ganymede, the Chinese had chosen that moment to launch heavy assaults on our units. We were in total chaos. A few more casualties and Commander Harris would have had no option but to surrender. It was pure luck that we managed to regroup, but luck was all we had left.
Try to recapture the Recycler. You have no hope without it. We're trying to arrange backup from Ganymede to bust you out of there, but the Chinese have control of the portal. I'll keep you posted.
I'm in, Lieutenant. Now let's get out of here.
We're in trouble here, Lieutenant.
I don't know how much more we could take, Lieutenant.
This is bad, Lieutenant! We're going down!
We need help urgently, help us! Help!
Come in, Elysium, this is Ganymede calling. We are taking grave casualties. They require immediate assistance. Withdraw from Elysium immediately and destroy Pegasus as you leave.
Orders received and understood, comrade.
Initiate standing order Lima Romeo Seven.
Destruct sequence initiated.
Oh sweet Jesus, we're trapped!
Get to the portal, Lieutenant! You have to stop them from destroying it, and our scans are showing Chinese bombs incoming on your area. Get out of there!

Command once again thought they could take back control of the portal. With most of our troops on Elysium they probably could have done it. But no one could have predicted the next Chinese ploy. Command's decision to wait, before trying to regain control of the portal, nearly got us all killed.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Terra Incognita/bd07001.wav
transcript: Lieutenant, do you copy?

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Terra Incognita/bd07002.wav
transcript: Yeah, loud and clear, HQ.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Terra Incognita/bd07003.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Terra Incognita/bd07004.wav
transcript: Lieutenant, you now have the go-ahead to destroy the Chinese base. I say again, you now have the go-ahead to destroy the Chinese base.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Terra Incognita/intro07.wav
transcript: Elysium, the Isles of the Blessed. In Greek mythology the home and the afterlife of heroes and great men, but we didn't find a paradise. Just a dead planet in a galaxy far too distant for us to see from Earth. Its atmosphere was in the last stages of boiling off into space, and the ruins of the once great city were frozen and brittle. We set to work as soon as we arrived, ever conscious of the danger of Chinese attacks. Despite the portal which could take us instantly back to Ganymede, we felt completely alone on such an utterly bleak and alien world. At times like these, small groups of men like us must become tighter and present a unified front, or else collapse in a heap of petty rivalries. As it turned out, we had little chance to unite before the Chinese were upon us.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/The Best Laid Plans/bd15012.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/The Best Laid Plans/bd15013.wav
transcript: Minimum safe distance reached.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/The Best Laid Plans/intro15.wav
transcript: Command was wrong again. They had assumed that the Chinese, battered and undermanned, would surrender. But they had one more card up their sleeve. Planning for every scenario they had hidden a transport in a remote part of Ganymede, and they were heading straight for it. They were hoping to escape the Jovian system and take word back to China. We had to destroy every tank attempting to reach the transport, and then the transport itself. It wasn't going to be an easy target. We had no choice but to risk an all out assault on the largest piece of military hardware in the solar system.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/The Enemy Within/bd10001.wav
transcript: We need to destroy six key buildings here on Elysium. Their locations will be forwarded to you. You know your orders, Lieutenant. Now get out there and kick some ass.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/The Enemy Within/bd10002.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/The Enemy Within/bd10003.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/The Enemy Within/intro10.wav
transcript: We thought we had a ticket to glory in our cloaking field, which command used to infiltrate us into the dead center of the Chinese base. We were surrounded by their main production facilities. The destruction of these facilities would allow us to move in and take over the Chinese base. Or so we thought. As it turned out, our arrogant attempt to establish our own base inside the Chinese one came close to consigning us to a slow and lonely death.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Wolf in Sheep's Clothing/bd04001.wav

You and I are to place beacons around the crater at regular intervals, and then to wait further instructions. Captain Swallow, out.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Wolf in Sheep's Clothing/bd04002.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Wolf in Sheep's Clothing/bd04004.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Wolf in Sheep's Clothing/bd04008.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Wolf in Sheep's Clothing/bd04009.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Wolf in Sheep's Clothing/bd04010.wav

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Dogs of War/Wolf in Sheep's Clothing/intro04.wav
transcript: Our new Red Devil unit was proving useful against the invisible Chinese. But we weren't much better off than before. The boys started seeing the Chinese as being cowardly, and morale began to pick up as we banded together. We began to see ourselves as outgun fighters, struggling desperately against an oppressive foe. As our spirits began to lift, Command saw the ideal time to launch a major strike against the Chinese. But they didn't see how things were going to work out. Command had no idea how far we could go, how far we could push ourselves, because of one thing hope.
Your worthless performance on Ganymede sickens me. Think on it as you pilot your new Scavenger.
Hey, check out the new scav driver... Hey, scavy, fancy some target practice? Don't say that. He hasn't got any guns. Ahahaha…
Come in, Command, Sector 8, sweep complete. Moving on to a sector (static).

Say again, Scout 1. Repeat last transmission. Scout 1, do you copy? Scavenger 3, you are the closest unit to their last position. We have dropped a Nav Beacon at their last reported position. Go and investigate.
Follow that convoy, Scavenger Three. Has that Recycler been sent yet? Yes? Good.
The base is under attack. We have sustained massive casualties. Scavenger 3, you are the highest ranking officer left. Take command of the base and get things under control, now!
We have located the artillery, it is to your west.
Good work, Scavenger Three. Yes. Okay, Scavenger Three, High Command considers that you have… redeemed yourself. You may continue in command of the Elysium base.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Red Storm/From Out of Nowhere/ch03001.wav

We have obtained a Russian uniform for you and altered your sidearm to hold far more sniper rounds. Make your way to the Russian fiends Communication Tower and steal the information we need.

Excellent! The party will reward you well for your bravery. From the information you have found, we see that the convoy will be using the northern bridge. There are explosives hidden in some crates near the path they will take. Wait for the convoy and determine which vehicle is carrying the fragment of our property. As it passes the crates, use your sniper rifle to detonate the crates. Don't miss! The glory of the People's Republic is at stake!

Excellent! The party will reward you well for your bravery. From the information you have found, we see that the convoy will be using the eastern bridge. There are explosives hidden in some crates near the path they will take. Wait for the convoy and determine which vehicle is carrying the fragment of our property. As it passes the crates, use your sniper rifle to detonate the crates. Don't miss! The glory of the People's Republic is at stake.
All units, intruder alert! Security perimeter breach, intruder alert!
You have approximately three minutes before the convoy reaches the bridge, Major.
Imbecile. The APC has passed the crates.

The Russians have access to the full range of technologies contained within the Pegasus. Your foolishness has lost our strategic advantage. Do not bother to return to the field headquarters. We have already left for Ganymede.
You honor yourself and the People's Republic, Major. Now that the Russians have no trace of the Pegasus device, they cannot build their own. Now return to the drop zone as quickly as possible.
Welcome back, Major, now let us return to Ganymede.

transcript: You have failed us, Major. We are most disappointed in you. Don't bother returning to headquarters. Our sentries have orders to shoot you on sight.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Red Storm/Out There Somewhere/ch06001.wav
transcript: There is a large CCA base in your sector. We have sent reconnaissance patrols to find it. Once they find it, you are to strike hard and fast, destroying other units. Intelligence suggests that the Soviets are using a long-range power supply. Some buildings may not be as helpless as they seem.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Red Storm/Out There Somewhere/ch06002.wav
transcript: Command, we have found the Russian base. I say again, we have found (static). We have dropped a Nav Beacon, Major. Avenge their deaths.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Red Storm/Out There Somewhere/ch06003.wav
transcript: Hello, comrades. We have been instructed to assist you in defeating the CCA bugs. We are en route to your location, ETA five minutes. Why were we not informed of this? Uh, we have suffered a loss of our communications tower.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Red Storm/Out There Somewhere/ch06004.wav
transcript: Okay, this will be difficult. You are welcome to join our strike against the Russian pigs.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Red Storm/Out There Somewhere/ch06005.wav
transcript: What? What's going on? Why are you… Major?! They are Russian units. Destroy them instantly!

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Red Storm/Out There Somewhere/ch06006.wav
transcript: It seems that the Russians made use of the Factory that we left on Ganymede. We suggest that you are more careful when you attack the Russian base. They may have more of our units.

relative_path: The Red Odyssey/Red Storm/Out There Somewhere/ch06007.wav
transcript: Good work, Major. We believe that there is no longer a Russian presence on Elysium. Return to Ganymede as quickly as possible. You are required for a delicate mission on Europa.
Our engineers have set to work on the Pegasus relic, show them how the Red Army protects the people and the Republic, and fend off the Russian attacks while they work.
Incoming CCA forces, sir.

The engineers require a supply of Cobalt 7 phase regulators. We have requested these from headquarters. They will arrive shortly. What? General Fu? Major, we have a most unexpected honor upon us. General Fu is to make an inspection of the base. He will arrive with the shipment of engineering components. Make sure he arrives unscathed. I'm sure you have heard the stories of the punishments he gives for incompetence.
Major, this is General Fu. We are under attack. I suggest you are there quickly. If I have to use my own sidearm, you'll know (unintelligible)!

Well done, Major. Not only have you defended our engineers against the Russian enemy, you have also saved the Red Army considerable, uh, embarrassment. The problems that could have arisen if General Fu had been harmed. Well, let us not dwell upon them.
You have failed the Republic, Major! Your dishonor knows no bounds.
Scramble all units! Russian Walker approaching! This is the pilot of Golem Omega-7. I am a political asylum seeker. I see no point to this struggle. Comrades, I come in peace.
Well, it seems we have another new piece of equipment for the struggle.

Major! We are running short of bio-metal. We suspect that the Russians are hoarding it in their silos. One of these hoards is nearby, but it is surrounded by minefields. We have dropped Nav Beacons to mark a safe path through them. Follow the path and find out how much scrap they have stored.
Core coolant failure. Shutting down cloaking device.
(Cloaking failure alarm).
As we thought, they are stockpiling scrap, now get back to base.
What are you trying to do, Major? You are a most weak and feeble leader. You will be replaced.
I have seen better navigation skills in school, Major. I suggest you resign your commission at the earliest opportunity.
Follow the safe path we have marked out, Major.
We’re being overrun (unintelligible)! Retreat to the portal. All units, retreat!
